zh: 有多就有少，由总会开出『划条』交阜康向欠头寸的钱庄先收现银。时间规定是在第二天下午两点钟以前。那么，缺头寸的钱庄怎么办呢？不要紧，第二天上午可以到公会向有头寸多的同行去拆进，利息以日计，称为『银拆』这种一两天的同业借款，不必打收据，由公会记一笔帐就可以了。至于利息的计算，又分两种，不打收据的拆借，称为『活拆』，利息高低视银根松紧而定。另外一种同业长期的拆借，称为『呆拆』，要立票据，议定利息；在此期间，不受每天挂牌的『银拆』的影响。『这种打「公单」的法子，就好象赌钱发筹码，所不同的是，第一，赌场的筹码，只有头家可以管；公单只要是汇划钱庄，家家可开。第二，赌场的筹码，不能拿到外面去用，公单可以化成本号的银票，到处可用。说实了，无非无中生有，凭空生出几千万银子来；所以现银不过一百万，市面上的大生意照样在做。这就是要汇划的把戏。』接下来便谈到丝茧的情形。丝茧业下乡收值，多仰赖钱庄放款，胡雪岩也就因为有钱庄在手里，所以成为丝业领袖，这两年因为抵制新式缫丝厂，收的茧子与丝更多。宓本常虽非胡雪岩经营丝业方面的档手，但可以从各联号存放款进出的总帐中，看出存货有多少。
en: Where one bank had a surplus, another had a deficit. The association issued a transfer order authorising Fukang to collect silver from a bank short of funds, with payment due before two the following afternoon. What could the bank in deficit do? No matter: the next morning it could borrow through the association from another bank with a surplus. Interest was calculated by the day, the transaction being called a “silver loan”. Such interbank advances for a day or two required no receipt, only an entry in the association’s books. There were two methods of charging interest. Loans without receipts were “floating advances”, their rates rising and falling with the money market. Longer interbank loans were “fixed advances”, supported by written instruments at an agreed rate, unaffected by the daily quotation. “Issuing public clearing certificates is like handing out gambling counters,” Mi explained. “There are two differences. First, only the house controls a casino’s counters, while every participating bank can issue these certificates. Second, casino counters cannot be spent outside. A clearing certificate can be converted into the bank’s own notes and used anywhere. In plain terms, it creates something from nothing—tens of millions of taels out of thin air. That is why great transactions continue even though there is only a million in actual silver. That is the clearing trick.” They then turned to silk and cocoons. Buyers going into the countryside depended largely on bank loans. Hu’s control of a bank had helped make him a leader of the silk trade. During the past two years, his campaign against modern reeling mills had led him to buy still more cocoons and silk. Mi did not manage the silk business, but could judge the size of its stocks from the consolidated records of deposits and loans at the branches.

zh: 『大先生，』宓本常神情严肃地说∶『现在存丝总有六七千包，茧子更多，我看用不着这么多存货。』『你是说吃本太重？』『是啊。』宓本常说∶『粗估一估差不多有三百万银子的本钱压在那里。不是因为这样子，古先生的十万银子，我也不好意思来讨。』『呃！』胡雪岩立即接口∶『这十万银子转到我名下。』他紧接着又转脸对古应春说∶『另外的，再想办法。好在你有地皮在那里，不过现金一时周转不开而已。』古应春满怀忧虑一扫而空；但自己虽不愁了，又为胡雪岩发愁，『小爷叔，』他说∶『现在三家缫丝厂都缺货，你何妨放几千包茧子出去；新式机器，做丝快得很，一做出来，不愁外洋没有买主，那一来不就活络了？』『古先生这话一点不错。』宓本常也说，『今年「洋庄」不大动，是外国人都在等，等机器的丝，凭良心说，机器做的丝，比脚踏手摇土法子做的丝，不知道要高明多少。』『我也晓得。』胡雪岩用低沉的声音说∶『不过，做人总要讲宗旨，更要讲信用，说一句算一句，我答应过的，不准新式缫丝厂来抢乡下养蚕做丝人家的饭碗，我就不能卖茧子给他们。现在我手里再紧一紧，这三家机器缫丝厂一倒，外国人没有想头了，自然会买我的丝，那时候价钱就由我开了。『古应春与宓本常，都认为他打的如意算盘。不过，古应春是好朋友的身分，而宓本常是伙计，所以只有古应春还可以劝他。
en: “Sir,” Mi said gravely, “there must now be six or seven thousand bales of silk in stock, and still more cocoons. I do not think we need so much.” “You mean too much capital is tied up?” “Yes. At a rough estimate, nearly three million taels are immobilised there. Otherwise I would be ashamed to press Mr Gu for his hundred thousand.” “Ah!” Hu answered at once. “Transfer those hundred thousand to my account.” He turned to Gu. “We shall find a way with the rest. You have the land, after all. It is only a temporary shortage of cash.” Gu’s own anxiety vanished, but concern for Hu took its place. “Little Uncle, all three reeling mills are short of material. Why not release a few thousand bales of cocoons? The new machines work very quickly. Once the silk is made, there will be no shortage of foreign buyers. Would that not get things moving?” “Mr Gu is quite right,” Mi said. “The export buyers have been inactive this year because the foreigners are waiting for machine-reeled silk. In fairness, it is far superior to what our old foot-driven and hand-turned methods produce.” “I know,” Hu said quietly. “But a man must have principles, and above all he must keep his word. I promised not to let modern mills steal the livelihood of country families who raise silkworms and reel silk. I cannot sell them cocoons. If I tighten my grip a little longer and those three mills collapse, the foreigners will have nothing to wait for. They will buy my silk, and then I shall name the price.” Both Gu and Mi thought this wishful calculation. But Gu was a close friend, Mi an employee; only Gu could continue trying to persuade him.

zh: 『小爷叔，如果那三家新式缫丝厂倒闭了洋商当然只好仍旧买我们土法子做的丝；可是那三家厂不倒呢？』『不倒而没有货色，跟倒了有啥两样？』『还有一层，小爷叔要想到，茧子虽然烘干了，到底也还是摆不长的。一发黄就卖不起价钱了。』『这话是不错。不过，你说上海现银不到一百万，我就放茧子出去，也换不出现银。』『有英镑、有花旗票就可以了。』宓本常接口来个快，『譬如说，现在要还汇丰五十万，如果大先生有卖茧子的外国钱在汇丰，就可以折算给他，收进五十万现银，周转不就活络了？』胡雪岩沉吟了一会说∶『为了维持我的信用，只好抛茧子，这话我说得响的。明天我去看邵小村，看看这五十万两银子，到底收得齐收不齐？如果银数不够，决定照你们的办法，卖茧子来拿它补足。不然，我另有主意。』『小爷叔，你是啥主意？』胡雪岩笑笑，『天机不可泄漏。』他说，『是蛮狠的一着。』
en: “Little Uncle, if the three mills close, foreigners will naturally have to buy our traditionally reeled silk. But what if they do not close?” “If they have no material, what difference does staying open make?” “There is something else to remember. Dried cocoons still cannot be stored indefinitely. Once they yellow, they lose their value.” “True. But you say Shanghai has less than a million taels of silver. Even if I release the cocoons, I cannot turn them into cash.” “Sterling or American notes would do,” Mi put in quickly. “For example, you owe HSBC five hundred thousand. If the foreign currency from selling cocoons were deposited there, it could be converted and credited against that sum. Bringing in five hundred thousand in silver would free up our funds, would it not?” Hu considered. “If I must sell cocoons to preserve my credit, that is a reason I can stand behind. Tomorrow I shall see Shao Xiaocun and find out whether the full five hundred thousand can be collected. If it falls short, I shall follow your proposal and sell cocoons to make up the difference. Otherwise, I have another idea.” “What idea?” Hu smiled. “Heaven’s secrets cannot be revealed. It is a rather ruthless move.”

zh: 吃完了饭，宓本常告辞，古应春却留了下来，因为胡雪岩刚到上海，尚未露面，到第二天消息一传，应酬就会忙不过来，那时候就没有工夫细谈了。当然胡雪岩也要跟他谈谈近况，第一个关切的是七姑奶奶，『怎么样？』他问∶『七姐好点了？』『好得多了。』古应春的神气不同了，显得很有生气的模样，『本来右半身完全瘫了，现在有点知觉了。』『那好！说不定还会复原呢！』这一说，使得古应春很不安，只好老实说了，『小爷叔，我心里有个疙瘩，从瑞香一进门，没有几天就有消息。顾林在英国女皇的行宫外面，从马上摔下来，把脑子摔坏了。』他迟疑着说∶『我怕她跟我八字上不大相配。』『！』胡雪岩大不以为然，『你蛮洋派的人，怎么也相信这个。要不然，你拿你们两个人的八字，叫吴铁口去合一合看。』提到吴铁口，不免令人失笑；当初罗四姐去合八字，原是七姑奶奶跟他串好一的出双簧。胡雪岩也知道其中的奥妙，竟真的相信吴铁口是真的铁口，岂非自欺欺人？『你笑点啥？』胡雪岩说∶『你当我荒唐？实在说一句∶假的说成真的，「真的是真的，那就是不折不扣的铁口。』听他说得象绕口令似的，古应春不由得笑了，『好，好！我听小爷叔的话，叫吴铁口去合她的八字，不过，』他说∶『她的八字我不晓得。』『我来问她。』『慢慢，总要等阿七有了表示以后。』『当然。』胡雪岩说∶『我明天看了七姐，包你当天就有好消息。』
en: After dinner, Mi took his leave, but Gu stayed. Hu had only just arrived in Shanghai and had not yet appeared publicly. Once the news spread tomorrow, social obligations would leave no time for a long conversation. Hu too wanted to hear his recent news. His first concern was the Seventh Lady. “How is Seventh Sister? Any better?” “Much better.” Gu’s expression brightened. “Her whole right side was paralysed. Now some feeling has returned.” “Good! Perhaps she may recover completely.” This made Gu uneasy, and he had to speak frankly. “Little Uncle, something troubles me. Only a few days after Ruixiang entered our household, the news came that Gulin had fallen from his horse outside the British queen’s country palace and injured his brain.” He hesitated. “I fear her birth signs may not agree with mine.” Hu strongly disagreed. “You are so Western in your ways. How can you believe that? If necessary, take both sets of birth particulars to Wu Ironmouth and let him compare them.” Mention of Wu was enough to provoke a smile. When Madam Luosi had once consulted him about birth signs, it had been a performance secretly arranged with the Seventh Lady. Hu knew the trick. To believe Wu’s pronouncements genuinely infallible now would be deceiving himself and others. “What are you smiling at?” Hu asked. “Do you think me ridiculous? Let me say this: when a falsehood is made true, and the truth really is true, that is an infallible Ironmouth.” Gu laughed at the tongue-twister. “Very well. I shall do as you say and ask him to compare her birth signs. But I do not know her birth particulars.” “I shall ask her.” “Wait. We must first have some indication from A’qi.” “Of course. Once I see Seventh Sister tomorrow, I guarantee good news that very day.”

zh: 『怎么？』古应春问∶『小爷叔是打算当面她明说。』『当面是当面，不是明说。你到明天就晓得了。』『复原是办不到，只望她能够起床就好了。』古应春又说∶『谈到这一点，实在要谢谢瑞香。』『对了！』胡雪岩谈到他第二件关心的事，『七姐对瑞香怎么样？』『那没有话说，当她自己妹子一样。当然这也一半是看罗四姐的面子。』『照这样说，应该是照她的锦囊妙计，一步一步走拢来；七姐对你有没有表示？』『有。不过我没有答腔。』『咦！』胡雪岩大为诧异∶『为啥？』『小爷叔，你看我现在弄得这样焦头烂额，哪里还有讨小的意恳。』『这倒也是实话。』胡雪岩问∶『阜康的十成旭不必再提了，你还差多少头寸？』应春想了一下答说∶『还差十二、三万。』『差点是现款，能够变现就好。』胡雪岩说∶『我再借五百包丝给你，你洋行里的朋友多，总可以卖得掉。』古应春打的正是这个主意，踌躇好久，难于启齿，不想胡雪岩自己说了出来；心里的那份感激与痛快，难以形容了。『小爷叔，你真是杭州人说的，是我的「救命王菩萨」。』他说∶『我把道契都抵给你。』
en: “What? Do you mean to speak to her directly?” “Face to face, yes; directly, no. You will see tomorrow.” “Complete recovery is impossible. I only hope she can get out of bed,” Gu said. “For that, we really must thank Ruixiang.” “Exactly!” Hu came to his second concern. “How does Seventh Sister treat her?” “There is nothing to complain of. Like her own younger sister. Of course, half of that is out of regard for Madam Luosi.” “Then we should follow the ingenious plan she gave us, step by step. Has Seventh Sister said anything to you?” “Yes, but I did not answer.” “Why?” Hu was astonished. “With my affairs in such a mess, Little Uncle, how could I think of taking a concubine?” “True enough. Leaving aside the hundred thousand at Fukang, how much more do you need?” Gu thought. “Another hundred and twenty or thirty thousand.” “What you lack is cash. Anything you can turn into cash will serve. I shall lend you five hundred bales of silk. With all your friends in foreign firms, you should be able to sell them.” This was precisely what Gu had hoped for but had long hesitated to ask. Now Hu had offered it himself. Gu’s gratitude and relief were beyond description. “Little Uncle, as we say in Hangzhou, you are my life-saving King Bodhisattva. I shall pledge all the title deeds to you.”

zh: 『不必，不必，我们弟兄何在乎此？不过应春，你开价不能太低，不然，有个盘口在那里，以后我就抬不高了。』『是的。』古应春凝神想了一下说∶『这样，小爷叔，你索性再借两百包给我∶七面百丝抵押十四万银子，一定可以，那就什么都摆平了。』『好！光押不卖，就不算把行情压低。准定如此。』胡雪岩紧接着说∶『你现在有心思想瑞香了吧？』这一点，古应春还是不能爽爽快快地答复；沉吟未答之际，胡雪岩少不得要追问了。『这件事老太太都蛮关心的。罗四姐更不用说，应春，你要晓得，不光是你，她对瑞香也要有个交代。』第二天一大早，胡雪岩就到了古家。七姑奶奶已知道胡雪岩要来，叫瑞香替她栉发梳妆；又关照预备菜留胡雪岩吃饭，大为兴奋。
en: “No need. Between brothers, why trouble about that? But you must not ask too low a price. Once a market quotation is established, I cannot raise mine later.” “Yes.” Gu thought carefully. “Then lend me another two hundred bales. I can certainly raise a hundred and forty thousand taels by pledging seven hundred bales. That will settle everything.” “Good. Pledging without selling will not depress the market price. We shall do that.” Hu added immediately, “Now can you think about Ruixiang?” Even so, Gu could not answer freely. As he hesitated, Hu pressed him. “My mother is concerned about this, and Madam Luosi even more so. Remember, Yingchun, it is not only you. She owes Ruixiang an answer too.” Early the next morning, Hu went to the Gu household. The Seventh Lady knew he was coming and had Ruixiang comb her hair and help her dress. She also ordered food prepared so that he could stay for a meal, and was much excited.

zh: 胡雪岩一来，当然请到病榻前面，『七姐，』他很高兴地说，『看起来精神是好得多了。』『是啊，都要谢谢四姐。』『为啥？』『不是四姐派了瑞香来帮我的忙，我不会好起来，小爷叔你看！』七姑奶奶将右手提高了数寸，『现在手能够动了，都是瑞香，一天给按摩多少遍。』『喔！』胡雪岩看一看瑞香，想要说话，却又住口，仿佛有难言之隐似的。七姑奶奶虽在病中，仍旧神智清明，察言辨色的本事一点也不差；殷殷地从胡老太太起，将胡雪岩全家大小都问到了。直到瑞香离去，她才问道∶『小爷叔，刚才提到瑞香，你好象有话没有说出来。』
en: Hu was naturally shown straight to her sickbed. “Seventh Sister,” he said gladly, “you do look much stronger.” “Yes. It is all thanks to Fourth Sister.” “Why?” “If she had not sent Ruixiang to help me, I would never have improved. Look, Little Uncle!” She raised her right hand a few inches. “I can move it now. Ruixiang massages it so many times every day.” “Oh!” Hu glanced at Ruixiang as though about to speak, then stopped, suggesting something difficult to say. Though ill, the Seventh Lady remained clear-minded and as skilled as ever at reading faces. She enquired warmly after everyone in Hu’s household, beginning with his mother. Only when Ruixiang had left did she ask, “Little Uncle, when we mentioned Ruixiang, you seemed to leave something unsaid.”

zh: 『是的。我有句话，实在不想说，不过又非说不可。』『那么，小爷叔我们两家是一家，你说嘛！』『话句话是罗四姐要我带来的。』胡雪岩说∶『瑞香是好人家出身，他哥哥现在生意做得还不错，想把他妹子赎回去。』『赎回去？』七姑奶奶脸色都变了，『当初不是一百两银子卖到胡家的？』『不是。罗四姐弄不清楚，我也记不起来，捡出老契来一看，才知道当初是典的一百两银子，规定八年回赎；今年正好是第八年。』『那，四姐的意思呢？』『四姐当然不肯，尤其听说在你这里还不错，更加不肯了。』『四姐待我好。』七姑奶奶用殷切盼望的眼色看着胡雪岩说∶『她晓得我离不开瑞香，应该替我想想办法。』『办法何尝不想。不过，她哥哥说出一句话来，四姐就说不下去了。』『喔，一句什么话。』『她哥哥说，要为她妹子的终身着想。意思是把瑞香赎回去，要替她好好寻个婆家。』『真的？』看七姑奶奶是不信的语气，胡雪岩也就正好说活终话，『哪晓得他是真是假？不过，』他又把话说回来∶『男大当婚，女大当嫁，就算他是假话，也驳不倒他。三个人抬不过去一个理字。七姐，你说呢？』
en: “Yes. There is something I do not want to say, but must.” “Then say it. Our two families are one.” “Madam Luosi asked me to bring this message. Ruixiang comes from a respectable family. Her brother’s business is doing fairly well now, and he wants to redeem her.” “Redeem her?” The Seventh Lady’s expression changed. “Was she not sold to your household for a hundred taels?” “No. Madam Luosi was uncertain, and I could not remember. We found the old contract and discovered that she had been pledged for a hundred taels, with redemption after eight years. This is the eighth.” “What does Fourth Sister think?” “Naturally she does not want to let her go, especially after hearing how well she is doing here.” “Fourth Sister is good to me.” The Seventh Lady looked at Hu with eager hope. “She knows I cannot do without Ruixiang. She ought to find a way for me.” “She has tried. But her brother said something she could not answer.” “What?” “He said he must consider his sister’s future. He means to redeem her and find her a good husband.” “Really?” The disbelief in her voice gave Hu room to manoeuvre. “Who knows whether he means it? Still,” he turned the argument back, “when men and women grow up, they should marry. Even if he does not mean it, we cannot refute the reason. Three men together cannot carry away a sound argument. What do you say, Seventh Sister?”

zh: 『依我说，』七姑奶奶微微冷笑，『小爷叔，你手下那么多人，莫非就不能派一个能干的去打听打听他哥哥的情形，是真的为瑞香着想呢，还是说好听话，拿他妹子赎回去，另打主意？』『打啥主意？』『知人知面不知心。照瑞香这份人材，在她身上好打的主意多得很。』胡雪岩不作声，这是故意作出盘马弯弓的姿态，好逼七姑奶奶往深处去谈。七姑奶奶此时心事如麻，是为瑞香在着急；盘算了好一会，方又开口说道∶『小爷叔，你同四姐决不可以让瑞香的哥哥把她赎回去。不然会造孽。』『造孽？』胡雪岩故意装出吃惊的神气，『怎么会造孽？』『如果瑞香落了火坑，不就是造孽？』『七姐，』胡雪岩急急问说∶『你是说，她哥哥会把她卖到堂子里？』『说不定。』胡雪岩想了一下说∶『不会的。第一，瑞香不肯；第二，她哥哥也不敢。如说我胡某某家的丫头，会落到堂子里；他不怕我办他一个「逼良为娼」的罪？』『到那时候就来不及了。小爷叔，你既然想到你的面子，何不早点想办法？』
en: “I say,” she answered with a faint, cold smile, “that with so many people working for you, surely you can send someone capable to investigate her brother. Is he really thinking of Ruixiang, or merely saying pleasant things so that he can redeem her for some other purpose?” “What purpose?” “You can know a man’s face without knowing his heart. With Ruixiang’s looks and qualities, there are plenty of plans he might make for her.” Hu said nothing, deliberately holding his horse and drawing his bow, as it were, to force her further into the subject. The Seventh Lady’s thoughts tangled with anxiety for Ruixiang. After considerable reflection she said, “You and Fourth Sister must not let him redeem her. It could be a terrible sin.” “A sin?” Hu feigned alarm. “How?” “If she fell into the pit of fire, would that not be a sin?” “Do you mean,” Hu asked urgently, “that he might sell her to a brothel?” “He might.” Hu considered. “I do not believe so. First, she would refuse. Second, he would not dare. If a maid from my household ended in a brothel, would he not fear my prosecuting him for forcing a respectable woman into prostitution?” “By then it would be too late. If your reputation concerns you, why not find a way now?”

zh: 『对！』胡雪岩很快地接口，『七姐，你倒替我想个法子看。』『法子多得很。第一，同他哥哥去商量，再补他多少银子，重新立个卖断的契。』『不，不！这点没有用。』胡雪岩说∶『如果有用，罗四姐早就办了。我不说过，人家生意做得蛮好，赎瑞香不是打钱的主意。』『好！就算他不是打钱的主意，诚心诚意是为瑞香的终身；不过，他替他妹子到底挑的是什么人家？男家好不好要看一看；瑞香愿不愿意也要问一问。如果是低三下四的人家，瑞香又不愿意，小爷叔，那就尽有理由不让他赎回去了。』『这话——』胡雪岩不便驳她太武断，急转直下地说∶『我看，只有一个办法，他为瑞香好，我们也是为瑞香好，替瑞香好好找份人家，只要瑞香自己愿意，他哥哥也就没话说了。』七姑奶奶想了一下说∶『小爷叔，我想请四姐来一趟，请她来劝一劝瑞香。』『劝啥？』胡雪岩答说∶『莫非我就不能劝她？』『我怕小爷叔说话欠婉转；瑞香是怕你，就肯答应，也是很勉强的。这种事，一勉强就没有意思了。』『什么事要瑞香答应？而且要心里情愿？七姐，你何妨同我实说；你晓得的，我们家的丫头都不怕我的，倒是对四姐，她们还有忌惮。』『即然如此，我就实说吧！小爷叔，我在瑞香来的第二天，心里就在转念头了，我一直想替应春弄个人，要他看得上眼，要我也投缘，象瑞香这样一个拿灯笼都寻不着的人，四姐替我送了来，我心里好高兴；本想等小爷叔你，或者四姐来了，当面求你们，哪知道其中还有这么一层曲折，真教好事多磨了。』『七姐，你说实话，我也说实话。』胡雪岩很恳切地答道∶『我们也想到，你要有个好帮手，凡事能够放心不管，病才好得起来。不过你们夫妻的感情，大家都晓得的，这件事只有你自己来发动，我们决不好多说。如今七姐你既然这样说了，我同四姐没有不赞成的。不过，这件事要三方面都愿意。』『哪三方面？』七姑奶奶抢着问说。
en: “Exactly!” Hu responded quickly. “Suggest one for me.” “There are plenty. First, bargain with her brother. Pay him more and draw up a new contract for outright sale.” “No, that would be useless. If it could work, Madam Luosi would have done it already. Did I not say his business is doing well? He is not redeeming her for money.” “Very well. Suppose he truly cares about her future. What sort of family has he chosen? We must see whether the man’s household is suitable, and ask whether Ruixiang is willing. If the family is disreputable and she unwilling, there is every reason to prevent her redemption.” “Well—” Hu could hardly tell her how arbitrary that was, so changed direction. “I think there is only one course. He wishes her well, and so do we. Let us find her a good marriage. If she herself agrees, her brother can have nothing to say.” The Seventh Lady considered. “I should like Fourth Sister to come and persuade her.” “Persuade her of what? Could I not do it?” “I fear you might not be tactful enough. Ruixiang is afraid of you. Even if she agreed, it might be unwillingly. There is no point in forcing a matter like this.” “What must she agree to, and willingly? Tell me plainly. You know our maids are not afraid of me. If anything, they are more in awe of Madam Luosi.” “Then I shall speak plainly. On the second day after Ruixiang arrived, I began thinking of it. I have always wanted to find someone for Yingchun, someone he would like and with whom I too would feel at ease. Fourth Sister sent me Ruixiang, a girl one could not find even by searching with a lantern, and I was delighted. I meant to wait until you or Fourth Sister came and ask in person. Who could have imagined this complication? Good things meet so many obstacles.” “Since you speak frankly, so shall I,” Hu answered earnestly. “We too thought you needed a good helper, someone to whom you could leave matters without worry, so that you might recover. But everyone knows the closeness between you and your husband. The initiative had to come from you; we could not say more. Now that you have spoken, Madam Luosi and I can only approve. But all three parties must agree.” “Which three?” she asked quickly.

zh: 『你，应春，还有瑞香。』胡雪岩紧接着说∶『瑞香我来劝她；我想，她一定也肯的？』小爷叔，你怎么晓得她一定肯？『『我们家常常来往的女太太，不管是亲戚，还是朋友，少说也有二、三十位，一谈起人缘，瑞香总说∶』要算七姑奶奶「，从这句话上，就可以晓得了？『胡雪岩编出来这套话，使得七姑奶奶面露微笑，双眼发亮，显然大为高兴。『七姐，』胡雪岩问说∶『现在我要提醒你了，你应该问一问应春愿意不愿意。』『他不愿也要愿。』七姑奶奶极有把握地，『小爷叔你不必操心。』『不见得。』胡雪岩摇摇头∶『去年他去拜生日，老太太问过他，他说他决不想，好好一个家，何苦生出许是非？看来他作兴不肯讨小。』七姑奶奶『哈』一声笑了出来，『世界上哪个男人不喜欢讨小？』她说∶『小爷叔，你真当我阿木林？』『阿木林』是洋场上新兴起来的一句俗语，傻瓜之意。胡雪岩听她语涉讥嘲，只好报以窘笑。
en: “You, Yingchun and Ruixiang. I shall speak to Ruixiang. I think she will certainly agree.” “How do you know?” “Among the ladies who visit our house, relatives and friends, there must be twenty or thirty at least. Whenever we speak of whom everyone likes best, Ruixiang always says, ‘The Seventh Lady.’ That tells us enough, does it not?” Hu’s invented story brought a smile to her face and a brightness to her eyes. She was plainly delighted. “Now I must remind you to ask whether Yingchun is willing.” “Willing or not, he will have to be,” she said confidently. “You need not worry.” “Not necessarily.” Hu shook his head. “When he came for my mother’s birthday last year, she asked him. He said he would never consider it. Why bring trouble into a happy home? He may well refuse a concubine.” The Seventh Lady laughed aloud. “What man in the world does not like the idea? Do you really take me for an amulin?” Amulin was a new expression in the foreign settlement, meaning a fool. At her mocking tone, Hu could only answer with an embarrassed smile.
